label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/ssrf): alert-TP — User-controlled 'host' parameter flows directly to connectHttpByHostname() which opens outbound connections. The isNonPublicAddress() check only validates pre-DNS-resolved addresses, but DNS resolution itself (via InetAddress.getByName()) can be manipulated by attackers. The resolved sink value at line 44 is the user-provided 'host' parameter passed to URL.openConnection(), which can point to internal services via DNS rebinding or controlled DNS records. Thread.sleep(50) does not mitigate the SSRF vulnerability.

evidence.note: User input param assigned to host variable without full validation
DNS resolution followed by direct connection to user-controlled host
